newsitem.title: GERMANY: German state to start digital TV trial programme.
newsitem.headline: German state to start digital TV trial programme.

text.p: Media officials from the southwestern German state of Baden-Wuerttemberg said on Thursday the state planned to launch a trial programme for digital broadcasting on the region's cable network.

The upgraded cable network will be used to carry digital television channels and regional programming, as well as for new media services, the state authority for communication in Baden-Wuerttemberg (LfK) said.
"The test project will also broadcast those programmes that until now could not be allowed in the analogue area because of the lack of channels available," the LfK said in a statement.
It added that another goal of the trial was to test how effectively the digital platform could be marketed by stations and technical service providers selling programmes or programming packages.
The Kirch Group-owned digital pay TV network DF1, has already expressed interest in taking part in the new scheme, the LfK said.
